en.title: Notice on English Graduation Certification Special Lecture for Candidates for February 2027 Graduation Evaluation
summary: Notice on free English graduation certification special lecture for February 2027 graduation evaluation candidates (including completed coursework students (수료자)).
Eligibility: Candidates with a record of submitting an official English test score report below the qualification criteria to their department office by the application deadline.
How to apply: Inha Portal System > Academic Affairs > Academic Affairs Internet Application > [Graduation Certification TOEIC Special Lecture] > select class time and save.
Lecture period: December 28, 2026 – January 8, 2027 (online asynchronous class).
en.easyExplanation: This is a free online special lecture for students undergoing graduation evaluation in February 2027 (including students who have completed coursework (수료자)) who have submitted an official English test score report below the threshold to their department office. You can apply via the Inha Portal System from December 21, 2026, 09:00 to December 22, 2026, 16:00. Upon satisfying the evaluation criteria, you will obtain English graduation certification.
en.target: Candidates for graduation evaluation in February 2027 (including academic degree completed coursework students (학사학위 수료자)). Students without a record of submitting an official English test score report (TOEIC (Speaking), New TEPS, OPIc, etc.) below the qualification criteria to their department office by the application deadline are not eligible to apply.
en.eventInfo: Online asynchronous special lecture for English graduation certification.

2. 신청자격: 2027년 2월 졸업심사대상자(학사학위 수료자 포함)
단, 신청종료일까지 자격기준에 미달되는 공인영어성적표(토익(스피킹), New TEPS, OPIC 등) 제출기록 필수(제출할 곳: 학과사무실); 제출기록이 없는 학생 신청불가
3. 신청방법: 인하포털시스템 로그인→ 학적→ 학적인터넷신청→
[신청종류] 졸업인증토익특강→ 수강희망반 선택(오전반/오후반)→ [저장]
4. 반 배정결과 및 유의사항
가. 반 배정결과(오전반 또는 오후반) 학교 홈페이지 안내: 2026.12.24.(목) 15:00∼
나. 유의사항
(1) 수강인원이 편중(오전 또는 오후)되면 신청순서에 따라 임의로 분반배정 예정
(2) 평가결과(출석, 과제, 시험성적 등)에 따라 영어졸업인증 취득여부 판정
다. 인하졸업인증제 안내: 학교홈페이지→학사→졸업/증명서발급→인하졸업인증
5. 문의처: 소속학과 사무실, 학사관리팀 (전화번호: 교내 9319, Email: hanna@inha.ac.kr)
※ 수업운영 방식과 관련된 문의는 담당교수님께 이메일로 문의해 주시기 바랍니다.
